registry: trusted_qa_runs + trusted_qa_run_entities: exact product entity and marker; upload URL recorded in entity payload and sanitized local state
preflight: Read-only account/ID/code/timelineCode/run availability and registry privileges passed on 2026-10-03. Recheck immediately before creation.
allowedActions: edit then Cancel and verify unchanged record
one fixture file upload to external-draft
verify current photo unchanged before Apply

cleanup.at: run TTL or earlier explicit scope completion; never clean another active run
cleanup.method: Verify registry ownership, exact ID/code/marker/account/context, then canonical cleanupTrustedQaRun in a transaction; verify product inactive and registry cleaned
cleanup.retainedArtifacts: One inactive QA product, its applied fixture image and audit registry remain as the canonical soft-cleanup record. No physical deletion or broad storage cleanup.
cleanup.onMismatch: Mark the exact run blocked and stop; no fallback cleanup.

controllerCompatibility: Current production-block controller has no menu QA kind. Its automatic timeline/certificate QA stays disabled; this enabled manual menu scope must be explicitly included in the same owner authorization. Do not describe the release QA as none.
